title: DAPHNE top-5 basket
question: Does a branch-and-bound condition search on plain level trades find an edge that holds after 2024?
verdict: Does not hold out of sample; the search as a whole is chance level. Paper only, never routed. 1,127,006 nodes searched over 80 roots, 54.6% cut by the bound; 31/80 best rules hold out of sample (38.8%) vs 31.2% / 35.0% with shuffled conditions: no better than chance.
notes: Train <= 2024-12-31 (so 2021-24 is in-sample), test 2025-26. Sized at $282 risk a trade.

rules: Short at the Asia low on a 5-minute close through it, stop 1 tick beyond the break bar, target 2R, out after 120 min, only when the 09:30 open is above the middle of yesterday's range; the entry is within 0.4 ATR of the 09:30 open; the entry is between 10:00 and 14:00 ET; 30-day volatility is in quintile 2 to 5

Long at the opening-range low after a sweep and reclaim, stop 1 tick beyond the sweep low, target 2R, out after 120 min, only when yesterday's VIX closed 20 or more; the daily trend is down (yesterday's close vs its 20-day EMA); the entry is between 9:50 and 11:00 ET; the 09:30 open is above yesterday's low; 30-day volatility is in quintile 4 to 5

Short at the London low on a 5-minute close through it, stop 1 tick beyond the break bar, target 2R, out after 120 min, only when the 09:30 open is in the high half of yesterday's range; the entry is between 10:00 and 12:00 ET

Short at the overnight low on a 5-minute close through it, stop 1 tick beyond the break bar, target 2R, out after 120 min, only when 30-day volatility is in quintile 2 to 5; the entry is between 10:00 and 13:00 ET; the 09:30 open is inside yesterday's range; the entry is at least 0.15 ATR from the 09:30 open

Short at the opening-range low on a 5-minute close through it, stop 1 tick beyond the break bar, target 2R, out after 120 min, only when it is a Tuesday; yesterday's VIX closed 15 or more; the entry is between 9:50 and 11:00 ET

method: exact live-loop replay (20-day window per session) + cold-streak filter + sizing; costs included
